query: SELECT json_build_object('source_pages',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages s JOIN public.books b ON b.id=s.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND s.source_page BETWEEN 304 AND 308),'topics',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics t JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=t.chapter_id JOIN public.books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND c.slug='europe' AND t.slug IN ('local-government-reference-questions-source-page-304','bangladesh-education-source-reference-page-305','education-abbreviations-institutions-source-page-306','national-professor-education-institutions-source-page-307','education-reference-questions-source-page-308')),'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 304 AND 308),'notes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 304 AND 308),'mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 304 AND 308),'mcq_options',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 304 AND 308),'verifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 304 AND 308),'flashcards',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0304-0308:%'),'search_documents',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_facts f ON d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id=f.id WHERE f.source_page BETWEEN 304 AND 308)) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
